reddit.title: Improving Performance: Cutting Flowing Water Cost
reddit.body: We've made significant optimizations to how flowing lakes are processed in Provincia. By refining our approach, drying a single cell no longer requires rescanning the entire map. This change reduces the script time for a 64×64 lake from about 20 ms to just 12 ms, while maintaining the same depth. Check out the details in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost

posts: Exciting news! We've optimized the way flowing lakes work in Provincia. Instead of rescanning the whole map when one cell dries, we now only refresh the affected chunk and its neighbors. This has significantly improved performance. Learn more here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost

steam.title: Provincia Update: Enhanced Flowing Water Performance
steam.body: We're excited to announce that we've improved the processing of flowing lakes in Provincia! By optimizing how we handle wet cells, we've reduced the script time for a 64×64 lake from approximately 20 ms to 12 ms. This means smoother gameplay and less lag. For all the details on these changes, check out our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost
